svg.title: μ-harmony（黄金比，2026-11-07）
svg.desc: Native vector ribbon combining a quarter note and u. The right full axial height, including the U bowl, is the golden larger share of the left full axial height, including the entire notehead. A shared smooth axial deformation shortens the left upper arm while preserving the notehead, right side and lower joins.
svg.metadata: Sketch and brand direction: human author, Magma. Early image iterations: GPT-5.6 Luna and GPT-Image-2.5 (user-reported). SVG co-design and web optimization: GPT-6. This website SVG is an approximation; archival master remains unchanged.
